originalTitle: Trump says Exxon and Chevron made 'too much money' off high oil prices during Iran conflict: 'I don't like it'
summary: U.S. crude oil prices have gained about 20% since the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.
content:
President Donald Trump said Monday that ExxonMobil and Chevron made "too much money" on rising crude oil prices due to the Iran war.

"They're making too much money based on a shortage," Trump told reporters at the White House. "I don't like it."

Exxon and Chevron on Friday reported windfall profits for the second quarter. Chevron's earnings soared nearly 400% to $12 billion compared to $2.5 billion in the same period last year. Exxon's profits more than doubled to $14.5 billion compared to $7.1 billion in the year-ago period.

"Chevron, too much money. ExxonMobil, too much money," Trump said. "They're going to give some of that back to the public and they better cut the retail price, the consumer price."

CNBC has reached out to Exxon and Chevron for comment.

U.S. crude oil prices have gained about 20% since the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28. Tehran has retaliated by trying to choke oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz, triggering the largest supply disruption in history.

U.S. oil futures had an average closing price of around $92 per barrel from April through June, about 27% higher than the first quarter.

Gasoline prices, meanwhile, averaged about $4.10 per gallon nationwide on Monday, nearly 40% higher compared to the $2.98 per gallon that drivers paid on Feb. 27 before the war started, according to data from AAA .

Chevron's shares were down nearly 2% while Exxon traded slighly lower after Trump's comments. The oil majors' stocks were already under pressure Monday as crude prices fell about 5% on hopes that U.S.-Iran talks might prevent further escalation.
chineseTitle: 特朗普称埃克森美孚和雪佛龙在伊朗冲突期间从高油价中赚了“太多钱”：“我不喜欢这样”
chineseSummary: 自2月28日美国和以色列袭击伊朗以来，美国原油价格已上涨约20%。
chineseContent:
唐纳德·特朗普总统周一表示，埃克森美孚和雪佛龙因伊朗战争导致的原油价格上涨“赚了太多钱”。

特朗普在白宫对记者说：“他们因短缺而赚了太多钱。” “我不喜欢。”

埃克森美孚和雪佛龙周五公布了第二季度的意外利润。雪佛龙的盈利飙升近 400%，达到 120 亿美元，而去年同期为 25 亿美元。埃克森美孚的利润比去年同期的 71 亿美元增长了一倍多，达到 145 亿美元。

“雪佛龙，太多钱了。埃克森美孚，太多钱了，”特朗普说。 “他们将把其中的一部分返还给公众，他们最好降低零售价和消费者价格。”

CNBC 已联系埃克森美孚和雪佛龙征求评论。

自2月28日美国和以色列袭击伊朗以来，美国原油价格已上涨约20%。德黑兰进行报复，试图阻止霍尔木兹海峡的石油出口，引发历史上最严重的供应中断。

4月至6月美国石油期货平均收盘价约为每桶92美元，较第一季度上涨约27%。

与此同时，根据 AAA 的数据，周一全国汽油价格平均约为每加仑 4.10 美元，比战争开始前 2 月 27 日司机支付的每加仑 2.98 美元高出近 40%。

特朗普发表评论后，雪佛龙股价下跌近 2%，埃克森美孚股价小幅走低。石油巨头的股票周一已经承压，因希望美伊谈判可能阻止局势进一步升级，原油价格下跌约 5%。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
